name: gtd-brain
title: GTD Brain
description: Capture anything to your GTD Brain Inbox and work your Next Actions, Projects, Waiting For and Someday/Maybe lists without leaving the keyboard.
author: minosin

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Capture to Inbox
commands.subtitle: GTD Brain
commands.description: Write a thought down with optional notes; it lands at the top of your Inbox.

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.subtitle: GTD Brain
commands.description: Type it and press Enter — straight to the top of your Inbox, no form.

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Inbox
commands.subtitle: GTD Brain
commands.description: Clarify your Inbox: move each card to Next Actions, Projects, Waiting For or Someday/Maybe, or archive it.

commands.name: next-actions
commands.title: Next Actions
commands.subtitle: GTD Brain
commands.description: Your Next Actions by context. Mark one done or change its context.

commands.name: projects
commands.title: Projects
commands.subtitle: GTD Brain
commands.description: Your Projects with the next action pinned to each.

commands.name: waiting-for
commands.title: Waiting for
commands.subtitle: GTD Brain
commands.description: Everything delegated: who you are waiting on and since when.

commands.name: someday-maybe
commands.title: Someday/Maybe
commands.subtitle: GTD Brain
commands.description: Ideas you are incubating. Activate one into Next Actions when its time comes.
